notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes: I changed the video codexs to all the videos in game since one of the plugins had a conflict with anything not a specific codex.

notes.title: Bug fixes and new features
notes.notes:
It became known to me that there is some bugs with the videos being shown. I did some small changes that seem to work. Please tell me if it doesn't, but from what it seems, it is a GPU driver bug I can't do much.

>Added the option to skip the tutorial/intro video. This is mostly for people replaying the game or people who don't want to watch the video.

>Added sprite animations to the enemies.

>Made the battles and the animations faster.

>Hopefully fixed the video bug fully for people with different hardware by adding a small check before playing to make sure it doesn't happen.

notes.title: Some small but important changes
notes.notes:
I have thought about this a lot wondering if I should improve it by replacing some stuff or keeping somethings the same with how minor it is. But I have decided to change certain things in the game:

>Replaced cyberpimp.ogg with a new brand song

>Changed some demon names and dialogue a tiny bit

The overall experience isn't changed, it is just some minor changes that needed to be made. This only affects one of the bosses in the game and it was made for the better.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes: Fixed a bug with the ingame map

notes.title: First Major update
notes.notes:
Hello!

For everybody playing before release and people buying at launch, some new features were added:

>Minimap functionality added, you can now view the minimap at all times.

>lots of bug fixes after a massive testing and searching for bugs, most minor bugs should be fixed now.

>Updated the credits to include more people who supported the game's development as of late.
